# f5xc_alert_receiver (Data Source)

Alert Receiver Alert Receiver is used to specify a receiver (slack, pagerDuty, etc.,) to send the alert notifications. An Alert Receiver may be associated with one or more Alert Policy objects, which defines one or more routes to match the incoming alert.
